in_hindi.name: अलीमुद्दीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: Alimuddin is an Arabic name that in Hindi is transliterated as अलीमुद्दीन. The name is derived from the Arabic words 'Ali' meaning 'exalted' or 'sublime' and 'mud-din' meaning 'slave of the Prophet'. Therefore, the long meaning of Alimuddin in Hindi is 'sublime slave of the Prophet'.

in_marathi.name: Alimuddin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Exalted one of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Alimuddin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Alimuddin is a combination of two words: 'Ali' and 'Muddin'. 'Ali' means 'Exalted' and 'Muddin' means 'One of God'. So, Alimuddin can be interpreted as 'The Exalted One of God'.
